title: Increasing Numbers of Foreign Domestic, Healthcare and Childcare Workers
what_it_is: Increasing Numbers of Foreign Domestic, Healthcare and Childcare Workers

sections.label: Expanded school intakes, Adapt and Grow
sections.summary: Local school intakes for medical, nursing and early childcare programmes were expanded, and Adapt and Grow Programmes help mid-career professionals take up these jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For example, the intakes in local schools for medical, nursing and early childcare-related programmes have been expanded in recent years to attract more Singaporeans to join these sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We have also established Adapt and Grow Programmes to facilitate the transition of mid-career professionals who wish to take up these jobs.

sections.label: Foreign workers and FDW support
sections.summary: Companies can access foreign workers for shortfalls, and FDW levy was lowered to $60 with AIC grants for families and caregivers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Where there are shortfalls, companies will continue to have access to foreign workers to fill in the gaps in numbers, skills and timing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To provide support to such families, the concessionary FDW levy rate was lowered from $120 to $60 per month since May 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) also provides a means-tested monthly grant of $120 to support families who need to hire a FDW to care for a family member who requires permanent assistance with daily living activities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The AIC provides a Caregivers Training Grant (CTG) to help offset the cost of attending approved training for caregivers of seniors and persons with disabilities, including FDWs who support families in caring for such persons.

sections.label: MOM reviews manpower needs
sections.summary: MOM will review manpower needs for all sectors, including healthcare and childcare, and work with MOH on elderly care projections.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: The short answer to the Member's query is that MOM will constantly review the manpower needs for all the sectors, including the healthcare and childcare sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: And particularly for the healthcare centre, the need for elderly care, we will also work closely with MOH to estimate and also to do a projection on the number of the elderly who will need such care and the number of workers needed by these institutions so that we will be able to revise and calibrate our manpower policies from time to time.
